open_world.dialogue: Hi builder! Welcome in this new region, the Dustline!
open_world.quest_offer: You made it out to the frontier, I'm actually impressed. The Dustline is a very old region that never held on the core and for this region, it's not destructed. However, the noticeboard at the saloon fell apart and Mabel need your help to rebuild it as a proper website. Just make one that present yourself as a new builder!
open_world.quest_done: WAOU well done! The frontier is proud of you!
open_world.trial_reminder: You're still on that noticeboard? Get to work and don't forget to log your hours and to commit often! You can ship it once you're done.

open_world.dialogue: Hi! I'm Mabel, I work at the saloon. I would really love your help as it has become a bit dry since the music stopped to come...
open_world.quest_offer: I think you are competent enough to build me a custom and original MP3 player! Imagine it as you want it, there is no limit of what it can do/have! Maybe think of a jack port, a screen, buttons or even joysticks or external speakers!! Don't be limited and believe in you to make the most original and beautiful MP3 player for the saloon!
open_world.quest_done: WOW 'm so proud of you, the saloon will revive thanks to that!
open_world.trial_reminder: Is that music that I hear? Oh... It's only in my head... Please build that MP3 as fast as you can builder!
open_world.trial_name: A Music player for the saloon

open_world.dialogue: I really need help to contact more hack clubbers on earth. The problem is that the line really went quiet...
open_world.quest_offer: The relay has carried messages around the region for centuries, without any link to the Core. This relay has been broken. Build me a repeater, 2 devices that can messages each other over radio only! It can be either with morse, or vocal messages, or anything as long as it comes from your imagination!
open_world.quest_done: Good jobbb! The relay is in good hands now.
open_world.trial_reminder: The repeater is still broken?? You can do it pal!
open_world.trial_name: Contact the hackclubbers on earth for more support!

open_world.dialogue:
Hi, I'm Tim! Since the Great Static broke everything, school ended and I now play Roblox all day long...
The problem is that there is no more new games I can play at, I've already explored every mods on Roblox...
You know what? I think you could build me a new game! And I would even give you all the Robux left in my account!
open_world.quest_offer: Make a new custom original game on Roblox for me. Plan it and build it with no limit to your creativity, make the new game you would have loved to play too!
open_world.quest_done: WOW it's amazing and so fun! Thank you so much I can now beat that boredom lol!!
open_world.trial_reminder: Pffff the days are very long without a new Roblox game...

open_world.dialogue: This saloon used to be joyful and music was playing all day long! Now that the jukebox is broken, it's just dust and silence. Are you good at software by any chance?
open_world.quest_offer: Mabel don't really know how to run the speakers...What I want is a jukebox that is a web app where anyone can play music, add some songs, play and pause, a volume knob, anything you can think of!
open_world.quest_done: That's good work! The saloon has gotten his music back and only thanks to you! You can be proud.
open_world.trial_reminder: That jukebox is still dead? You can do it trust

village.dialogue: Yo, you wanna see what you are working on rn? It's right here.
You have any question? Check out the docs, ask in the help channel or just check what I can answer right here!

Hiya builder! I'm Gabin, one of the survivor of the Great Static. Along with my friends Ridit and Ricky, I decided to look for help on the planet help!
That's why you are here today! You should definitely go talk to all the pixelians, they are very friendly and always have trials to give you!
See you soon for more adventures!!
